allow: Bash(powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$currentDate = Get-Date; $dayOfWeek = $currentDate.DayOfWeek; $currentHour = $currentDate.Hour; $isMondayMorning = ($dayOfWeek -eq ''Monday'') -and ($currentHour -ge 6 -and $currentHour -lt 12); Write-Host ''Day: ''$dayOfWeek'', Hour: ''$currentHour'', IsMondayMorning: ''$isMondayMorning -ForegroundColor Cyan")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat(updates): schedule updates for Monday mornings with force override

Updated update script to enforce weekly Monday morning schedule (6 AM - 12 PM) as per the workstation update frequency formula. This provides optimal balance between security and productivity.

Changes:
- Added -Force parameter to bypass schedule check when needed
- Script now checks day of week and time before running
- Displays helpful message with schedule info when run outside window
- Enhanced second brain logging to track day of week and force mode
- References new formula documentation for update frequency rationale

Usage:
- Normal: Script only runs Monday 6 AM - 12 PM
- Override: Use -Force flag to run anytime
- Documentation: See formula_workstation_update_frequency.md

Benefits:
- Prevents accidental mid-week disruptions
- Encourages consistent weekly maintenance
- Tracks adherence to update schedule in logs

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
